A '''cummerbund''' was an article of clothing. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once owned both a semi-formal [[Satyn/Legends|satyn]] cummerbund<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu" /> and a [[Velvoid/Legends|velvoid]] one. He used them to conceal small objects.<ref name="Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
